description: AWS Organizations root has no enabled service control policy type
rationale: An ALL-feature organization root with an explicitly disabled or absent SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY type does not enforce SCP guardrails for that root. This does not inspect attached policies or effective account permissions. Unknown/partial root data is not scored as secure.
remediation: Review whether SCP guardrails are required, enable SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY on the affected root, then review policy attachment and inheritance separately.
